fixes_applied.description: CpuNDArrayFactory.sort(INDArray, boolean, long...) called nativeOps.sort() (flat sort) instead of nativeOps.sortTad(). Fixed to call sortTad with dimension array and length.
sortGeneric() in specials_single.hpp used quickSort_parallel() which treated non-contiguous views as contiguous. Fixed with INDEX2COORDS/COORDS2INDEX path for non-contiguous arrays.
sortTadGeneric() called quickSort_parallel(dx, xTadLength, descending) passing xTadLength as numThreads. Fixed to call sortGeneric(dx, descending) per TAD.

sortTadGeneric() called tadForDimensions(..., false) where false=0 was passed as LongType dimLength. ConstantTadHelper::tadForDimensions with dimLength=0 creates a single whole-array TAD instead of per-row TADs. Fixed by passing dimensionLength instead of false.

BaseNDArray.putScalar(long i, double value) for rank-1 arrays wrote to data.put(i * stride(0), value) without applying the array's offset(). For rank-1 TAD views with non-zero offset (e.g., row 1 of a 2x2 matrix has offset=2), this overwrote the wrong buffer positions. Fixed by using offset() + i * stride(0).

Pre-existing VLMImagePreprocessor.defaultPreprocessor() references in 3 test files caused platform-tests to fail compilation when nd4j-api was updated. Replaced with fromModelDirectory(new File('.')) or fromConfig(new PreprocessorConfig()) in VisionEncoderUtilsParallelTest.
